# A01 (scout): requests to the lead

None of these block A01; each has a local adapter in place.

## 1. `safeFetch` needs POST (server/security/safeFetch.ts)

Workday's public CXS search is a `POST` with a JSON body. `safeFetch` only does
GET, so `server/sources/http.ts` carries a small local POST adapter with the same
connect-time private-address guard (`isBlockedIp` on every resolved address),
https only, no redirects, size and time caps.

**Ask:** add `method?: 'GET' | 'POST'` and `body?: string` to `SafeFetchOptions`
(POST: `redirect` treated as an error, `content-type: application/json` default).
Then `guardedPost()` in `server/sources/http.ts` can be deleted and the POST path
becomes `safeFetch(url, { method: 'POST', body })`.

## 2. Per-source health in `/api/sources` (server/routes/system.ts, A10)

The brief's acceptance says "per-source health is available through
`/api/sources`". That route is v1 and owned by A10, so A01 exposes health at
`GET /api/scout/health` instead (status ok / slow / failing / unavailable /
disabled / idle, last error, found / added / dupes, timing, boards ok/failed,
plus the JobSpy sidecar status).

**Ask (A10 or lead):** in `GET /api/sources`, add
`health: Object.fromEntries(sourceHealth().map((h) => [h.id, h]))` (import
`sourceHealth` from `server/scout/index.ts`) so the Sources page shows it next to
each connector. `CONNECTORS` already lists the 17 new connectors, so they appear
on that page with their enable switches as is.

## 3. Optional: keep the legitimacy reasons (server/db.ts)

`jobs.legitimacy` stores the verdict (ok / suspect / ghost / scam). The reasons
("asks the candidate for money", "reposted 3 times", "older than 30 days") are
computed but only logged. **Ask:** an additive `jobs.legitimacy_reasons TEXT`
(JSON array) column, so the UI and the matcher can explain a skip. A01 will fill
it the moment it exists (one line in `server/scout/ingest.ts`).

## Conventions other agents can rely on (no change needed)

- `jobs.priority`: +2 when posted within `freshHours` (default 48), +1 when the
  company has a hiring signal in the last 14 days. 0 to 3.
- `jobs.sources`: JSON array of `{ source, externalId, url, loc, seenAt }`, one
  entry per source that carried the posting.
- `jobs.tags` starts with normalised tags: `mode:remote|hybrid|onsite`,
  `visa:sponsors|no-sponsorship`, `level:intern|junior|mid|senior|lead`.
- `jobs.apply_url_canonical`: the employer's own posting URL when one is known
  (ATS), otherwise the cleaned listing URL. `jobs.ats` names the family.
- `jobs.company_id` → `companies.id` for every v2 row.
- Embeddings: `job_embeddings(job_id, model, vector)` is filled for every job the
  scout inserts (model `Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2`, or `hash-384` offline).
